units.source_statement: A separate heading The Sex begins historical speculation about an alleged thief's male/female category.
preconditions: The question is presumed to concern a thief identified by significators.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Not modern gender identification, legal evidence or an authentic identified suspect.

units.source_statement: A masculine hour lord, masculine seventh lord and masculine dispositor of the seventh are said to give a masculine outcome.
preconditions: All the listed planetary roles' sex class according to the historical system.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: The text has a multi-body clause, not merely one masculine planet.

units.source_statement: Masculinity of both Moon's dispositor and the planet Moon applies to is another masculine branch.
preconditions: Dispositor of Moon and Moon's applying planet are both masculine.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Lunar applicative direction matters.

units.source_statement: Thief significator in the source-designated masculine half-heaven (first, twelfth, eleventh, seventh, sixth or fifth), together with oriental status, is offered as a masculine indicator.
preconditions: Source describes named houses and oriental status.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: No real person category can be inferred from chart alone.

units.source_statement: Lilly says the contrary configurations to those stated are feminine.
preconditions: Evaluate the prior planetary/house/temporal conditions in reverse.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Source does not provide a calibrated third category or measurement error.

units.source_statement: A new heading Age offers several nonidentical ways to guess an alleged thief's years.
preconditions: Historical thief-significator chosen.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Do not treat multiple alternative formulas as independent people.

units.source_statement: Saturn as significator indicates old or aged person in author's age taxonomy.
preconditions: Saturn is actual thief significator.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Different from planet Saturn orientality affecting age separately.

units.source_statement: Jupiter, Mars or Sun as thief significator is used to assign an adult/man rather than very old or youth.
preconditions: The named planet is chief significator.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Does not give exact years.

units.source_statement: Mercury or Venus as significator indicates less aged person.
preconditions: Mercury or Venus holds the source role.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: An historical classifier with no validation.

units.source_statement: Moon in first quarter is assigned youth, second quarter older, third quarter more aged, final quarter greatest years.
preconditions: Moon phase/quarter is the selected age significator.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Author's gradual stages, not exact date-of-birth decoding.

units.source_statement: An oriental Moon or relevant planet indicates younger; occidental position indicates more aged.
preconditions: The relevant thief significator's oriental/occidental status is known.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: This may overlap/tension with planetary strength rules elsewhere.

units.source_statement: Lilly offers counting five years for every house the significator is distant from ascendant.
preconditions: Count the relevant houses from first, not merely any house index.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Historically suggested arithmetic, not tested numeric age estimator.

units.source_statement: Another age method counts two years per degree descending in the seventh house.
preconditions: A selected degree count in seventh house is available.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Ambiguous degree anchor: no false precision or automatic generalization.

units.source_statement: A further method compares the age implied by the planet to which Moon applies.
preconditions: Moon has a named applying planet.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Alternative to counting house distance.

units.source_statement: The author also takes elapsed days from a reference day of the month to the question day, multiplying each day by two years.
preconditions: One exact earlier day and current question day defined.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: This is authorial historical method; reference day choice ambiguous.

units.source_statement: Lilly explicitly recommends considering most of the alternative age methods and choosing the greatest amount of agreeing testimony.
preconditions: Multiple methods have separately produced source age indications.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Do not cherry-pick the formula that fits observed age in retrospective tests.

units.source_statement: A heading Forme and Stature introduces body-form guesses.
preconditions: Source thief significator, its sign and orientation.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Not an actual body identification, profile or discriminatory classifier.

units.source_statement: A significator with much orientality in Leo, Scorpio or Sagittarius is associated with a large/tall proportion.
preconditions: The named Leo/Scorpio/Sagittarius signs and significant orientality.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Original glyphs should be preserved; no biometric evidence.

units.source_statement: A significator with much occidentality in Cancer, Scorpio or Pisces is assigned smaller stature.
preconditions: The named water signs plus occidental influence.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Scorpio appears in both height lists with different conditions.

units.source_statement: A significator in Aries, Taurus or Leo is said to make the upper part of the thief's body thick/strong.
preconditions: Source chosen signifier in one of three signs.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Under historical form/stature section only.

units.source_statement: Sagittarius, Gemini or Scorpio is said to make lower body parts more pronounced.
preconditions: The relevant significator in one of three source signs.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Literal medical anatomy not implied; source taxonomy only.

units.source_statement: A new heading Fat begins a detailed bodily-proportion classification.
preconditions: Relevant planet physically representing the alleged thief.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Physical characteristics based on horoscope are not verified.

units.source_statement: Large latitude from ecliptic, retrogradation or first station are offered as alternative indications of a fat person.
preconditions: A planet significator with one of the stated astronomical conditions.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Original also lists specific sign portions; do not omit them.

units.source_statement: Early portions of Aries/Taurus/Leo or last portions of Gemini/Scorpio/Sagittarius are given as additional fatness signs.
preconditions: The thief significator in precisely the stated first/last sign regions.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Not necessarily a generic sign-wide condition.

units.source_statement: Moon in Cancer or Pisces is described as inclining to tallness in the fatness discussion.
preconditions: Moon placed in either sign.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: A different body attribute from fatness.

units.source_statement: Moon in Libra, Virgo or Aquarius is said to give flesh and good proportion.
preconditions: Moon in named signs.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Not an objective healthy-body classification.

units.source_statement: The heading Leane opens contrary body-form rules.
preconditions: Relevant thief significator is already selected.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Source notion of leanness is historical.

units.source_statement: Small latitude, direct motion or second station of relevant significator are taken as indicators of a lean body.
preconditions: One of three original planetary conditions.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Later author adds degree/sign conditions.

units.source_statement: Beginning portions of Gemini, Scorpio or Sagittarius, or extremity of planetary eccentricity, are offered as additional leanness indicators.
preconditions: Named sign portion or orbital condition.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: The list differs from previous last-portion 'fat' category.

units.source_statement: Sun beholding thief significator is separately said to give handsome shape and some fatness, despite appearing beneath the Lean heading.
preconditions: The Sun actually beholds the relevant significator.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Do not silently treat Sun as a leanness marker.

units.source_statement: Moon beholding significator is said to give temperance and moistness.
preconditions: A lunar aspect to relevant planet.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Historical humoral body-language, not medical fact.

units.source_statement: The heading The Thiefs strength introduces separate mobility/strength claims.
preconditions: The source selected planet continues to represent alleged thief.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: No corroborated physical capability inference.

units.source_statement: Thief significator in SOUTH celestial latitude is said to indicate nimble activity.
preconditions: South latitude of specific planet.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Source maps direction of latitude to gait, not empirical.

units.source_statement: Significator in NORTH latitude is said to indicate slow motion.
preconditions: North latitude of same selected planet.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Not necessarily weaker strength; source labels slow.

units.source_statement: Planet in first station is said to give stronger bodies.
preconditions: Actual first station rather than second.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Can conflict with source fat and age statements; separate domain.

units.source_statement: Planet crossing from one zodiac sign to another is said to indicate weak/feeble bodies.
preconditions: At sign boundary/ingress under author's interpretation.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Not generic all sign transitions.

units.source_statement: The heading Where the Knave is begins tracking whether a presumed fugitive keeps moving.
preconditions: The question presupposes an offender.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Not a real-person tracking capability.

units.source_statement: Significator passing from one sign into another is used to imply the presumed thief moves lodgings.
preconditions: Thief significator is about to change sign.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: No factual travel observation.

units.source_statement: Thief significator leaving combustion or the rays of Sun is another indication he moves.
preconditions: Leaving, not merely under Sun's rays.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Direction of exit matters.

units.source_statement: Thief's dispositor separating from ascendant lord and applying to a planet in sixth, eighth or twelfth is said to indicate flight or change of lodging.
preconditions: Specific prior separation and future application into one of the three named houses.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Not the same as an unconnected 6/8/12 planet.

units.source_statement: Thief and missing-good significators not occupying one quarter of heaven are said to imply greater distance or flight.
preconditions: Two source signifiers occupy different quarters.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: This is a categorical distance rule, not GPS.

units.source_statement: Thief significator or missing-thing significator applying to third/ninth lord, or themselves located in those houses, are further source-distance indications.
preconditions: A directed application or placement in third/ninth.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Do not count four alternatives as four crimes.

units.source_statement: The heading He remaines introduces a negative flight/continued-presence reading.
preconditions: A source-specific alternative to change/flight.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: The consequent may be elided in the printed sentence.

units.source_statement: First lord joined to a planet in a cadent house which beholds ascendant is offered under 'He remaines'.
preconditions: Lord1 joined to an actual cadent planet; aspect to ascendant.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: The next printed page begins a different heading rather than clear further predicate: retain dangling syntax.
